14:47: The Almighty says, confirming and affirming His promise: So do not think that God will fail to fulfill His promise to His messengers, that is, to support them in this worldly life and on the Day when the witnesses will stand. Then the Almighty informed that He is the Possessor of Might, and nothing He will prevent from Him nor will He be overcome, and the Possessor of Retribution against those who disbelieve in Him and deny Him. Woe, that Day, to the deniers, and for this reason He said: The Day when the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens as well, that is, His promise will be fulfilled on the Day when the earth will be replaced by another earth, and this will be in a manner other than the usual, well-known manner, as came in the two Sahihs from the hadith of Abu Hazim on the authority of Sahl ibn Sa`d, who said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: People will be gathered on the Day of Resurrection on a white, pure land like a loaf of bread, with no markings for anyone on it. Imam Ahmad said: Muhammad ibn Adi narrated to us, on the authority of Dawud, on the authority of Al-Sha’bi, on the authority of Masruq, on the authority of Aisha, that she said: I was the first person to ask the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, about this verse: The Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], she said: I said: Where will the people be on that day, O Messenger of God? He said: On the Bridge, narrated by Muslim alone, without Al-Bukhari, and Al-Tirmidhi and Ibn Majah on the authority of Dawud ibn Abi Hind, and Al-Tirmidhi said: Hasan Sahih. Ahmad also narrated it on the authority of Affan, on the authority of Wahib, on the authority of Dawud, on the authority of Al-Sha’bi, on her authority, but he did not mention Masruq. Qatadah said on the authority of Hassan ibn Bilal Al-Muzani, on the authority of Aisha, may God be pleased with her, that she asked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, about the statement of God: The Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], she said: I said: O Messenger of God, where will the people be on that day? He said: You have asked me about something that no one from my nation has asked me about, and that is that the people will be on the Bridge of Hell. Imam Ahmad narrated from the hadith of Habib bin Abi Amrah from Mujahid from Ibn Abbas that Aisha told me that she asked the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, about the words of God the Almighty: And the earth entirely will be in His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be rolled up in His right hand. So where will the people be on that day, O Messenger of God? He said: They will be on the back of Hellfire. Ibn Jarir said: Al-Hasan told us, Ali bin Al-Ja’d told us, Al-Qasim told us, I heard Al-Hasan say: Aisha said: O Messenger of God, On the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth. So where will the people be on that day? He said: This is something that no one has asked me about. He said: On the Bridge, O Aisha. Ahmad narrated it from Affan from Al-Qasim bin Al-Fadl from Al-Hasan with it. Imam Muslim bin Al-Hajjaj said in his Sahih: Al-Hasan bin Ali Al-Halwani told me, Abu Tobah Al-Rabi bin Nafi told me, Muawiyah bin Salam told us on the authority of Zaid, meaning his brother, that he heard Abu Salam, Abu Asma Al-Rahbi told me that Thawban, the freed slave of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, told him: I was sleeping with the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, when one of the Jewish rabbis came to him and said: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad. I pushed him so hard that he almost fell down. He said: Why did you push me? I said: Why don’t you say it, O Messenger of God? The Jew said: We only call him by the name that his family gave him. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: My name is Muhammad, which my family gave me. The Jew said: I have come to ask you. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: Will it benefit you at all if I tell you? He said: I am listening with my ears. The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, poked him with a stick that he had with him and said: Ask. The Jew said: Where will the people be on the Day when the earth is replaced by another earth and the heavens as well? The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: They will be in darkness beyond the bridge. He said: Who will be the first people to cross? He said: The poor immigrants. The Jew said: What will be their gift when they enter Paradise? He said: The extra liver of the whale. He said: What will be their food after that? He said: The bull of Paradise, which used to eat from its edges, will be slaughtered for them. He said: What will be their drink in addition to that? He said: From a spring in it called Salsabil. He said: You have spoken the truth. He said: And I have come to ask you about something that no one on earth knows except a prophet or one or two men. He said: Would it benefit you if I told you? He said: I will listen with my ears. He said: I have come to ask you about a child. He said: “The man’s fluid is white, and the woman’s fluid is yellow. When they come together and the man’s fluid rises above the woman’s fluid, they will produce a boy, by God’s permission. When the woman’s fluid rises above the man’s fluid, they will produce a girl, by God’s permission.” The Jew said: You have spoken the truth, and you are indeed a prophet. Then he turned away. The Messenger of God (peace and blessings of God be upon him) said: This man asked me about what he asked me about, and I had no knowledge of any of it until God brought it to me. Abu Ja`far ibn Jarir al-Tabari said: Ibn `Auf told us, Abu al-Mughira told us, Ibn Abi Maryam told us, Sa`id ibn Thauban al-Kila`i told us, on the authority of Abu Ayyub al-Ansari that a Jewish rabbi asked the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, and said: Tell me, when God Almighty says in His Book: The Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], where will creation be at that time? He said: Guests of God, and what He has will not fail them. Ibn Abi Hatim narrated it on the authority of Abu Bakr ibn `Abdullah ibn Abi Maryam. Shu`bah said: Abu Ishaq told us, I heard `Amr ibn Maymun, and perhaps he said: `Abdullah said, and perhaps he did not say, so I said to him on the authority of `Abdullah, and he said: I heard `Amr ibn Maymun say: The Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, he said: A land like pure white silver, in which no blood has been shed and no sin has been committed upon it, their sight will penetrate and the caller will hear them, barefoot and naked as they were created. He said: I think he said: Standing until sweat bridles them. It was narrated from another chain of transmission on the authority of Shu’bah, on the authority of Israel, on the authority of Abu Ishaq, on the authority of Amr ibn Maymun, on the authority of Ibn Mas’ud, in a similar manner. And it was also narrated by Asim, on the authority of Zur, on the authority of Ibn Mas’ud, in this manner. Sufyan al-Thawri said, on the authority of Abu Ishaq, on the authority of Amr ibn Maymun: He did not narrate it. Ibn Jarir included all of that. You will see, O Muhammad, on that Day the criminals - those who committed crimes through their disbelief and corruption - in pairs, meaning some of them with others, He has gathered together their peers or similarities, each type with another type, as the Almighty said: Gather together those who did wrong and their mates and He said: And when the souls are paired and He said: And when they are thrown therein into a narrow place, paired together, they will cry out there for destruction and He said: And the devils, every builder and diver, * And others paired together in chains and the chains are the fetters, as Ibn Abbas, Saeed bin Jubayr, Al-A'mash, and Abd Al-Rahman bin Zaid said, and it is well-known in the language.
